unit: WF4 Approval Gate returns INVALID for a blank decision string and never SENDs
description: A context that passes every structural and content check but carries an empty decision string must return gate INVALID, because the gate only ever SENDs on the explicit whitelisted verbs.
why_it_exists: Gate check step 6 of wf4/approval-gate.js refuses anything that is not an explicit whitelisted verb. The empty string is the sharpest instance of that whitelist: every other check has passed, yet a blank decision must not be coerced into an APPROVE-style send. This pins that a missing or blank decision fails closed as INVALID.

drafts.content: Our client requires the vehicle inspection report referred to in your letter of 14 January.

expect.note: Every structural check passes and the delivery identity IS derived, but the decision is blank, so the gate is INVALID, never SEND.

assertions: a blank decision string returns gate INVALID, never SEND
the refusal reads as Unrecognised decision, keeping the whitelist explicit
the delivery identity is derived (fields present) but is never turned into a SEND
dry_run is normalised to the boolean true and passed through on the refusal
Config keys survive the refusal untouched
